column17: Pickpocketing Knights of Ardougne can yield a consistent amount of gold with Rogue equipment. To optimise Thieving experience, it may be desirable to trap a knight to minimise their movement. This is frequently done inside the trapezoid-shaped house in the north-east corner, north of Ardougne Baker's Stall. To do this, the player should attack her once, go inside the house to lure them, and close the door behind them. A player with a dragon spear can use its special attack to aid in luring. Once they are inside, the player can lock them outside the room and log out and back in to reset aggro. After they are trapped, players should be courteous and keep the gate closed. Stand north of the knight in this location, as standing to the east or west of the knight for any extended time will cause the knight to be trapped on one tile, forcing it to despawn, then respawn in their original spawn point outside the house. Alternatively, hop worlds in the southern Ardougne bank to find someone splashing a knight. W343, W355 and W461 typically host a splasher. At lower thieving levels, this is recommended to allow easy access to the bank for food to sustain hitpoints as required. Further information on luring, with pictures, can be found at Thieving training. When using Shadow Veil 600 cosmic runes, costing coins, are required per hour if at level 50, or 300 at 99. Shadow Veil will increase actions per hour by skipping the stun effect resulting in more Thieving experience. At 95 Thieving, food and Shadow Veil are completely unnecessary since the player will no longer fail. At 95+ Thieving it is possible to gain 252,900 experience per hour and an accompanying 300,000 coins per hour with full rogue outfit.

column1: Money making guide/Recharging rings of wealth
column17: Recharging rings of wealth requires using them on the Fountain of Rune in high level Wilderness. This method utilises hopping to a free-to-play world while travelling to avoid getting killed. With an inventory of rings of wealth and a super energy potion, run to Wilderness on the east side of Varrock and hop the ditch. Restore run energy with the potion, then hop to a free-to-play world. Run to the Fountain of Rune, switch to a members world and charge the rings. Restore run energy again, switch back to free-to-play, and run south to level 30 Wilderness. Switch back to a members world and use one charge of a ring of wealth to teleport to the Grand Exchange. The Wilderness Obelisk in level 50 Wilderness can be used to travel, however travelling accurately requires the hard Wilderness Diary. Using this is about 40 inventories per hour, meaning approximately 1,100 rings per hour. Additionally, a Wilderness sword 4 from the elite Wilderness Diary will provide unlimited teleports directly to the Fountain of Rune which will increase the rates to 60-72 inventories per hour.

Collect loot from other players efficiently training Slayer by killing the Araxytes in the Morytania Spider Cave using the Venator bow. This guide assumes the other player is in max gear with a venator bow, getting kills per hour, some players may have weaker equipment, not be using a cannon, or not be maximising their damage, which will lower the expected kph. They may also use the Hallowfell, in which case reduce the expected kills per hour by about 30%, or more if they are also not using the best gear or methods. Some profit per hour may be lost in the time it takes to find a world with a suitable player, and as players will leave often from completing their slayer tasks you will need to wait for new ones or swap to worlds with more. Most valuable drops have a high alch price close to the grand exchange price. It is recommended to bring runes for the high level alchemy spell in order to extend the time that can be spent before banking. Many other drops are seeds or herbs which can be stored in the seed box or herb sack, respectively. Bringing these items will allow you to collect more drops. As araxytes are aggressive, you will need to wait out their 10 minute aggression timer in a corner behind some stalagmites so as to not take damage or need to maintain venom immunity, and to not interrupt the other player by drawing away the monsters they are fighting. An antipoison will be needed when first entering to cure the venom you will be applied with by the araxytes at the cave entrance, 2 doses should be consumed once you are in a safe area. Some food or the ability to pray Protect from Melee is also recommended for getting into position. It is recommended to avoid banking often to not waste time losing aggro multiple times. Players who are slaying araxytes will typically pick up the highest value drops and leave everything else. It is encouraged to communicate your intention to loot the drops that they leave behind. column17: The price of one hardleather body at Aaron's Archery Appendages. is 170 coins. If you have a stack of noted hardleather bodies available, you're able to sell them to the general store for a profit of each, considering a GEP of. The time it takes to withdraw a noted stack of items is effectively negligible when considering the potentially limitless amount you can sell to a store. Assuming you shift-jitterclick to sell items to stores, even if assuming extremely conservatively that you only sell 150 per game tick, this would effectively be a profit of per tick, or per hour. The buy limit of hardleather bodies (which is the limiting factor) is 125 every 4 hours. As a result, you will need to make an order and allow for it to fill (e.g. over night) in order to be able to do this for long periods of time. Due to this, the theoretical amount of hardleather bodies you can sell is severely limited; 1 hour of efficient body selling would take around 19,200 hours of waiting in order to fill the order. Due to this - assuming it takes around 1 minute to stop what you're doing to go to the Grand Exchange (and to later return to your previous activity), withdraw your bodies, get to the Al Kharid General Store and start selling them (you only need 1 free inventory slot) - also assuming you only do 20 hours worth of buy orders per batch (as to account for timezone/scheduling differences), your maximum bodies sold per hour is effectively only 36,000. Despite this, per day you should expect to only do a maximum of 625. Also, the first 10 items sold will sell for 40%, 37%... 13% respectively - selling for a total of 276 coins extra across those 10. This means you will have a slight increase in GP/hr by virtue of the EHP rate of selling to the store.

column2: Smelting adamantite bars with superheat item
column11: Starting bankroll to buy materials (recommended ~1,000,000 coins)
column17: Adamantite bars are frequently traded due to their use in smithing adamant equipment. Instead of visiting a furnace to smelt the bars, players with 43 Magic can cast superheat item to smelt ore into bars from anywhere. This costs the usual ore and coal, as well as a nature rune (and four fire runes, but this requirement can be ignored when a staff of fire is wielded). The advantages of using superheat item (instead of a furnace) is that the spell is faster than smelting at a furnace (4 ticks ~ 2.4 seconds) and the player doesn't waste time walking. This allows bars to be produced significantly faster (1300 bars/hour, or up to 1700 bars/hour when using Bryophyta's staff and a Tome of Fire), which more than makes up for the cost of the nature runes. The player still gets the usual 37.5 experience when creating a bar, plus 53 experience as well, making this a profitable way to train both skills. ==Bryophyta's staff and Tome of Fire== Note: This section does not apply to free-to-play, as the tome of fire is a members only item. By equipping Bryophyta's staff and a Tome of Fire, players can smelt four adamantite bars at a time. This method allows for up to 1,900 casts per hour. A drawback to this method is that the staff must be recharged approximately every 1,070 casts (or roughly every 34 minutes). When using only the filter "Show Utility spells" without "Enable icon resizing", if you withdraw 4 adamantite ores first, your mouse doesn't need to move when superheating. To completely offset the purchase price of the staff, players need to cast the spell times. If a player intends to resell the staff, they only need to offset the Grand Exchange tax, which requires casts. However, breaking even on the tax alone still takes almost hours of continuous casting. ==Optimised Banking using a staff of fire== Because the nature rune takes up an inventory spot, there is only enough space to make three bars per bank. However, with clever organisation, we can minimise the number of banking clicks. First, carefully withdraw the following quantities of items: - nature rune (many) - 9xadamantite ore - 18xcoal Cast superheat item on the adamantite ore three times. You now have - nature rune (many) - 6xadamantite ore - 3xadamantite bar Open the bank and 'Withdraw ALL' coal. This will add 18 coal to your inventory. Don't touch the ore or bars yet! - nature rune (many) - 6xadamantite ore - 3xadamantite bar - 18xcoal You now have the supplies to cast superheat item three more times. - nature rune (many) - 3xadamantite ore - 6xadamantite bar Open the bank and 'Withdraw ALL' coal again. This will add 18 coal to your inventory. Don't touch the ore or bars yet! - nature rune (many) - 3xadamantite ore - 6xadamantite bar - 18xcoal You now have the supplies to cast superheat item three more times. - nature rune (many) - 9xadamantite bar Open the bank a third time. 'Withdraw ALL' coal again. This will add 18 coal to your inventory. Now, you can 'Deposit All' (9) bars and 'Withdraw ALL' (9) ore. - nature rune (many) - 9xadamantite ore - 18xcoal You're now ready to perform the cycle again.

column2: Smithing adamantite bars at the Blast Furnace
column17: The Blast Furnace provides a great opportunity for players to reap great profits by producing a large volume of adamantite bars (worth each), which are used by high-level smiths. With moderate attention, you can produce between 2,400 and 2,700 adamantite bars in an hour. That means the profit margin falls between and hourly. This money making method requires you are on an official Blast Furnace world. Bring with you coal, adamantite ore, sufficient stamina potions, and at least coins. Deposit the coins into the coffer to be allowed to use the furnace by the dwarves operating it. The coffer will remove coins every minute automatically. Start by placing adamantite ore on the conveyor belt then empty your coal bag of coal and deposit that right after. Do two trips of just coal after, and in the second coal trip retrieve your bars from the bar dispenser by clicking on it (if ice gloves are equipped) or dousing it with a bucket of water and then collecting the bars. Then, do another trip of adamantite ore and coal, and immediately retrieve a second inventory of bars. Repeat this process from the beginning until you either run out of ore, or the coffer is empty. Alternatively, repeat these two steps: - Do a trip with a full coal bag and an inventory of coal. - Do a trip with a full coal bag and an inventory of adamantite ore. Collect the bars on every trip of just coal (other than the very first trip). The Coal bag allows you to bring 27 extra pieces of coal with you each trip from the bank to the furnace. Without using one, you should expect to earn a little more than one-half of the output totaling up to hourly and up to Smithing experience. After travelling to Keldagrim once, the city and the Blast Furnace can be easily accessed by using the travel option on the trapdoor on the inside west-wall of the Grand Exchange. Note: If you are buying all your ores and coal from the grand exchange, you can only do this method for about two hours before reaching the buy limit for both. Because of this, it is recommended to buy them in advance. column17: Chests are located inside the Rogues' Castle in Deep Wilderness. Requiring 84 Thieving, looting them can be one of the most lucrative thieving activities if player-killers can be managed. As always, players should not take anything they are not prepared to lose when it comes to the Wilderness. For specific information on equipment and procedure, along with calculations on rates, see Chest (Rogues' Castle)/Strategies. Player-killers are an inevitable part of the Rogues' Castle. This specific method involves committing suicide on their arrival or after around 15-20 minutes have passed, retrieving their items from Death's office (no death fees), banking, and returning to the chests, which can take only around 2 minutes. To minimise risk, untradeable prayer bonus items should be used. Prayer potion(2)s given by the chest will generally be lost as Wilderness supply piles but can sustain prayer after the single dose of Blighted super restore is used. Optionally, with practice it may become possible to keep health high enough to get a chance to escape up the stairs or manouever around the other side of the castle in order to buy time to log out, but this may cost more time than its worth, especially against freeze spells. A good method to do this is to wield a zamorak godsword and maximise slash attack and magic defence, such as with dragonhide, a warrior ring (i), rune or barrows gloves, warrior helm, and amulet of glory. Against a solo player-killer you can use your special attack once you're unfrozen to escape. Because the special attack has double accuracy you have a good chance of escaping, assuming the other player did not bring mithril or adamant seeds to prevent you from logging out underneath them, or a second player to catch an escape by running away. While the godsword's +8 prayer bonus may be beneficial to keep your prayer up, a crozier and book will be more effective and not reveal your escape strategy to a player killer before they reach you. 385 chests per hour would be a rough median for four interruptions. If uninterrupted, up to 425 chests can be opened per hour. If you cannot react to the player killers fast enough to die from the Araxyte venom sac, up to 500k profit will be lost if banking every 15-20 minutes. While only the medium Wilderness Diary is required to loot the chest, the average value of a chest increases by around 20% with the hard Wilderness Diary and that full bonus is used for this guide. Additionally, completing the hard Wilderness Diary enables choosing a destination when using the Wilderness Obelisks, which allows for significantly faster returns from death or banking. Without the hard diary, the number of chests opened per hour will be closer to 340 and around 15% off the profit there will be lost.

Black dragon leather is used to train Crafting, and it is always in high demand. Because black dragonhide must be tanned into leather before it can be crafted, tanning the hides in bulk can be highly profitable. Because the price difference between hides and leather can be fairly small, it is important to buy the hides for a low price and sell the leather for a high price; you can lose out on up to 50% of the profit if you are not patient. Test the profit by buying one black dragonhide and one black dragon leather. If the difference between the two is less than 200, it may be worth it to switch to green, blue or red dragonhide. To create black dragon leather, black dragonhide must be taken to a tanner. Ellis, in Al Kharid, is the quickest tanner, and there are no requirements to use him. Withdraw 27 black dragonhides from the bank south of the tanner and 20 coins for each hide you want to tan. Run north into Ellis's building and right-click Trade Ellis. Tan them all, and run back to the bank. Each run takes approximately 25 seconds while running, and 45 seconds while walking. This averages out to about 2,800 hides tanned per hour, yet a player can tan around 2,000 hides every hour without the use of energy or Stamina potions.

column1: Money making guide/Underwater Agility and Thieving
column17: Underwater Agility and Thieving involves swimming to loot open chests and clams for Mermaid's tears and Glistening tears. Each can be looted repeatedly whilst open, with a success rate based on your Thieving level ranging from 12.11% - 16.02%. Both types of tear are received in equal number, and both can be exchanged with Mairin for rewards. 400 Mermaid's tears can be used to purchase the Merfolk trident, whilst Glistening tears can be exchanged for a scaled amount of Experience in Thieving, Agility, or a combination of both based on the squared values of their respective levels. The shown experience rate of 422.8 per tear assumes that only Thieving experience is taken, and at the recommended minimum Thieving level of 65. That scales up to 974.8 per tear at 99 Thieving. Maximizing your tears per hour is mostly dependent on how efficiently you can navigate the Underwater area, though luck and your Thieving level do also factor in. A higher Agility level allows you to 'run' continuously for longer periods and regenerate Energy faster whilst looting. Those with a lower Agility level may wish to carry a few Super energy or Stamina potions to avoid running out of Energy. Whilst navigating the area, you're also required to maintain your Oxygen level without a Fishbowl helmet, adding an additional layer of complexity. Expected rates range from around 170 to 230 pairs of tears per hour.

column2: Picking up drops from Vyrewatch Sentinels
column17: Collect loot from other players farming by killing the Vyrewatch Sentinels in Darkmeyer. It is encouraged to communicate your intention to loot the drops that they leave behind. If The Blood Moon Rises is not completed, wearing the vyre noble disguise is extremely important to prevent Vyrewatch from attacking you. As this is a single-combat area, players who wish to kill Vyrewatch cannot do so. Players who are slaying Vyrewatch Sentinels will typically pick up the highest value drops (the blood shard foremost among them) and leave many other drops, including vampyre dust, a valuable drop in bulk. Vyrewatch Sentinels are commonly killed close to a bank, allowing quick banking and making picking up dropped vampyre dust worthwhile. Most non-vampyre dust valuable drops have a high alch price close to the Grand Exchange price. It is recommended to bring runes for the high level alchemy spell in order to extend the time that can be spent before banking; Vyrewatch Sentinels drop nature runes, so only a fire staff or other infinite fire rune source is required. You can setup custom menu swaps to hide left click attack or use the in-game settings to hide NPC Attack options, which will allow you to loot the ground more efficiently.

column17: The above output is calculated based on the player having a 61+ lap streak. Players who pay the 150,000 coin fee will gain access to the agility dispenser, which will reward them with items. The amount of loot offered per lap increases at discrete intervals: - 1-15 laps, 1x value - 16 - 30 laps, 2x value - 31 - 60 laps, 3x value - 61+ laps, 4x value The loot will be a split of alchables and noted blighted items. Players with at least one empty inventory slot will also be given one unnoted blighted item. If the player dies or leaves the agility course the lap streak will be reset. If the player logs out inside the course 10 laps will be deducted from their current streak. A Wilderness agility ticket will be rewarded per tag even if the player has not paid the 150,000 coin fee. Each ticket provides a base of 200 XP upon redemption which can be increased, up to a maximum of 230 XP if 101+ tickets are turned in. This can result in an additional 18,400 hourly XP from tickets. While building the reward streak from zero to maximum potential, a player would complete 15 laps of value 1, 15 laps of value 2, 30 laps of value 3, and 23 laps of value 4 (assuming 83 laps per hour). This makes the first hour worth (% compared to the maximum).
